name: Clicking the Final cell reaches a match detail page labeled Final
description: When a visitor clicks the Final cell in the bracket, the destination is a match detail page that explicitly labels itself as the Final — proving the Final cell is wired to a fixture, not a placeholder.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click the Final cell at the right edge of the bracket
Verify the URL after the click differs from the homepage URL

Verify the destination page surfaces a Final-stage indicator — accepting any of the literal text 'Final', 'FINAL', 'Final Match', 'The Final', 'Championship', 'Championship Match', a stage label/heading/breadcrumb starting with F, or a URL path segment containing 'final'
